import numpy as np
t=np.asarray(df['t']);P=np.asarray(df['P']);y=np.asarray(df['dP_dt'])
base=np.column_stack([1/P,np.log(1+P)**2])

import numpy as np
t=np.asarray(df['t']);P=np.asarray(df['P']);y=np.asarray(df['dP_dt'])
base=np.column_stack([1/P,np.log(1+P)**2])
L=np.log(1+P)
fams={
 'log(1+P)*(1-P/K)': lambda K,q: L*(1-P/K),
 'P*(1-L/K)': lambda K,q: P*(1-L/K),
 'P*(1-(P/K)^q)': lambda K,q: P*(1-np.abs(P/K)**q),
 'P*exp(-P/K)*(1-q*P)': lambda K,q: P*np.exp(-P/K)*(1-q*P),
 'P*(1-P/K)^q': lambda K,q: P*np.abs(1-P/K)**q,
 'P*(1-P/K)*(1+q*P)': lambda K,q: P*(1-P/K)*(1+q*P),
 'P^q*(1-P/K)': lambda K,q: np.abs(P)**q*(1-P/K),
}
for fn,f in fams.items():
    best=(9,None)
    for K in np.linspace(3,9,61):
      for q in np.linspace(-1.5,2.0,36):
        h=f(K,q)
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(h)): continue
        B=np.column_stack([base,t*h])
        c,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(B,y,rcond=None); r=y-B@c
        e=np.mean(r**2)/np.var(y)
        if e<best[0]: best=(e,(round(K,3),round(q,3)),np.round(c,4))
    print(fn,best)
